argv: set -eu; pool=/etc/php/8.5/fpm/pool.d/orbit-prod-scopes.conf; sections=$(grep -c '^\[orbit-' "$pool"); markers=$(grep -c '^php_admin_value\[opcache.validate_timestamps\] = 0$' "$pool"); [ "$sections" -ge 1 ] && [ "$markers" = "$sections" ] || { echo "$pool has $sections sections and $markers markers" >&2; exit 1; }; echo "app-prod pool renders $sections section(s) with the current OPcache template"
